_doc: Single source of truth for snow cams. Edit here, then run: python3 bin/camreg.py export  (regenerates cam_config.json + cam_routing.json for the ML model). See README 'Cam registry'.
adapter_notes: 2026-10-12: run 7 best on frozen test (original resorts); run 9 best on Sherpa bars; run 10 best/tied on batch-34 cams it was trained on (except powder_mountain). See TRAINING_LOGS.MD Run 10. 2026-11-09: run 11 (pile-height Sherpa labels) for aspen/highlands/buttermilk/snowmass; Sherpa storm MAE 1.1-1.2 vs run 9 2.2-3.2 (TRAINING_LOGS.MD Run 11).

model.label: Arapahoe Basin
model.note: Chevron logo board with vertical 1-18 inch ruler. Read snow piled at the base of the ruler (NOT on the adjacent tab).

model.label: Aspen Mountain
model.note: Aspen/Snowmass 'Sherpa Bar' design. Same as Snowmass.

model.label: Aspen Highlands
model.note: Aspen/Snowmass 'Sherpa Bar' design. Same as Snowmass.

model.label: Buttermilk
model.note: Aspen/Snowmass 'Sherpa Bar' design. Same as Snowmass.

model.label: Snowmass
model.note: Aspen/Snowmass 'Sherpa Bar': a watch flanked by two stepped wooden ladders.

model.label: Beaver Creek
model.note: Indoor decorative display: wooden wall, broken clock, thermometer, two chocolate-chip cookies, vertical 1-24 ruler. Mostly 0".

model.label: Breckenridge
model.note: White 1-24 inch ruler on a wooden platform. Read snow piled at the base.

model.label: Copper Mountain
model.note: Yellow 'SEND-O-METER' vertical 1-18 ruler with text labels (FRESHIES, POW DAY, DUMPING, DEEP, MEGA). Read snow piled at the base.

model.label: Crested Butte
model.note: Red Crested Butte board with a white ruler scale (2-18 inches) above a small white platform. Read the snow height on the platform against the scale.

model.label: Eldora
model.note: Illuminated orange tree-shaped marker inside a clear sphere; rungs labeled 1-14 in inches. Read highest visible rung label.

model.label: Keystone
model.note: Green 1-18 inch ruler. Read snow piled at the base of the ruler.

model.label: Loveland
model.note: Decorative sign with blue/yellow 2-20 ruler. Read snow piled at the base of the sign.

model.label: Monarch Mountain
model.note: Blue platform with vertical pole stake. Ruler marks ascending; read snow line at base of pole.

model.label: Purgatory
model.note: Black measuring board marked 2-22 inches under a 'Purgatory 60th Anniversary' sign, on a white base plate; cleared at 4pm. Read the snow height at the board base.

model.label: Ski Cooper
model.note: Thin red stake marked in inches standing on a wooden cable-spool table; cleared about 5am. Read the snow height on the table at the stake.

model.label: Taos Ski Valley
model.note: Black stake with white circles numbered 1-22 inches, mounted on a white snow board. Read the snow height at the stake base on the board. Image updates hourly.

model.label: Powderhorn Mountain Resort
model.note: Crescent-moon-shaped wooden sign with staggered numbers 2/4/6/8/10/12/14/16 on a flat dark surface. Read highest hidden number when snow piles on the platform.

model.label: Steamboat (Champagne Powder Cam)
model.note: TWO vertical poles each marked 2-28. Left pole labeled 'SINCE 4:00 PM' (resets daily), right pole labeled 'RECENT STORM TOTAL'. Read snow at base of each pole.

model.label: Sunlight Mountain
model.note: Semicircular blue/orange sunburst signboard with central tree-shaped wooden stake. Horizontal rungs labeled every 2 inches (staggered: left ladder has 4/8/12/16/20, right has 6/10/14/18). 'STORM' total on left platform shelf, '24 HOUR' on right. Read like sherpa_bar — highest rung whose label is hidden by snow pile. Valid: 0/4/6/8/10/12/14/16/18/20.

model.label: Vail
model.note: Blue 'VAIL' board with a ruler (1-20 inches) in front of a wooden fence; a separate clock/thermometer board stands to its left. Read the snow height at the base of the blue ruler board.

model.label: Winter Park
model.note: Vertical sign topped with 'Winter Park' header, red ruler 2-18 inches running down the middle. Read snow piled at the base of the sign.

model.label: Alta
model.note: Snowflake-shaped sign with 2-22 inch ruler down the middle. Read snow piled at the base of the ruler. Filenames are UTC, so many frames are night.

model.label: Snowbird
model.note: Vertical metal pole with tick marks at 2/6/10/14/18/22/26 inches, blue+green Snowbird chevron sign behind. Snow piles on a cleared platform at the base — read the snow line where the mound meets the pole, NOT the chevron panels.

model.label: Park City
model.note: White wooden platform with a tall vertical 1-23 inch ruler mounted on it. Platform is heavily cleared by staff so the base typically reads 0 even after storms; read the snow line on the ruler where snow piled on the platform meets it.

model.label: Sundance
model.note: Wooden sign with goggles motif and TWO vertical rulers (2-24) one left, one right. Left = 'OVERNIGHT' total, right = '24 HOURS' total. Read snow line at base of each ruler.

model.label: Brian Head
model.note: Teal arch-shaped sign with painted mountains and a vertical 2-24 ruler down the middle. Read the snow line on the ruler at the base of the arch.

model.label: Powder Mountain
model.note: Stacked-pucks pole at Hidden Lake Survey Site with marks 2-30 on both sides. Read snow line where mound meets the pole.

model.label: Deer Valley
model.note: Wooden board with brass deer emblem and ruler marks at 3/6/9/12/15/18/21 (every 3 inches). Read snow piled at the base of the board.

model.label: Snowbasin
model.note: '24 Hour Total' board: a vertical ruler marked 2-24 inches rising from a flat platform beside a carved sun sign. Read the snow height at the base of the ruler on the platform.

model.label: Big Sky (Andesite)
model.note: Black triangular Big Sky sign with a clock and TWO vertical rulers (2-28 inches). Read ONLY the LEFT ruler labeled '24 HOUR TOTAL' at its base; ignore the right 'STORM TOTAL' ruler.

model.label: Big Sky (Headwaters)
model.note: Black triangular Big Sky sign with a clock and TWO vertical rulers (2-28 inches). Read ONLY the LEFT ruler labeled '24 HOUR TOTAL' at its base; ignore the right 'STORM TOTAL' ruler.

model.label: Bridger Bowl
model.note: Red chairlift seat with a vertical ruler (2-20 inches) rising from the seat. Read the snow depth accumulated on the seat against the ruler.

model.label: Discovery Ski Area
model.note: Small brown vertical stake on wooden deck near a round thermometer. Ruler shows ~1-24 marks. Read snow line on the stake.

model.label: Grand Targhee
model.note: Vertical clear tube 'Stick of Truth' with inch marks visible (~1-20+). Decorative figurines around base. Read the snow line where the mound meets the tube.

model.label: Whitefish
model.note: Painted mountain scene with vertical 1-12 ruler 'SUMMIT SNOW CAM - Cleared Daily at 4PM'. Reads 24-hour snowfall (resets at 4PM daily, not total depth).

model.label: Boreal
model.note: Yellow ruler with black diamond markings (2, 6, 10, ... inches) mounted on a flat white platform. Read the snow height at the ruler base on the platform.

model.label: Northstar California
model.note: Maroon Northstar-branded board with TWO vertical rulers 1-25 (one left, one right). Left = 24-hour total, right = storm total. Read snow piled at base of each ruler.
